ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the horizontal axis is a time axis, from 0:00, 6:00, 12:00, 18:00 to 24:00 on the 11th, and continuing to 6:00 on the 12th; there is a north arrow N on the left side. On the time axis, a wind shaft is drawn near about 6:00, 12:00, 18:00, and 24:00 on the 11th. According to the explanation in the stem, the side of the wind shaft with wind barbs indicates the direction from which the wind comes: the early wind direction is roughly a northeasterly wind, then turns to an easterly wind, from southeasterly to southerly wind, and later turns to around a southwesterly wind. The wind direction in the figure changes continuously over time, indicating that the position of the cyclone center relative to the city is also changing. Reasoning: China is located in the Northern Hemisphere. A cyclone is a low-pressure system, and near-surface airflow converges counterclockwise. According to Buys Ballot's law, in the Northern Hemisphere, when standing with one's back to the wind, the low pressure or cyclone center is roughly in the left front. From the early northeasterly wind, it can be judged that the cyclone center is southeast of the city; as the wind direction turns to easterly and southerly, the center gradually approaches and passes near the city; the later appearance of a southwesterly wind indicates that the cyclone center has moved to the northwest of the city. Therefore, connecting these relative positions in chronological order, the cyclone center moves from the southeast toward the northwest.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中的时间轴和各时刻风杆，依据题干“风尾一方表示风的来向”逐个判读风向。再用北半球气旋逆时针辐合规律或白贝罗定律，把每个观测风向换算成气旋中心相对该城市的方位。按时间顺序把这些相对方位连接起来：早期中心位于城市东南方向，随后接近城市，后期位于城市西北方向，因此判断气旋中心由东南移向西北。
method.CoT_raw:

推理：我国位于北半球，气旋为低压系统，近地面气流呈逆时针辐合。按白贝罗定律，在北半球背风而立，低压或气旋中心大致在左前方。由早期偏东北风判断，气旋中心在城市的东南方向；随着风向转为偏东、偏南，中心逐渐接近并经过城市附近；后期出现偏西南风，说明气旋中心已移到城市的西北方向。因此按时间顺序连接这些相对方位，气旋中心是由东南方向移向西北方向。
